name: club-scoring
description: PHRF time-on-distance scoring for the yacht club

scripts.setup:club: python -m uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py setup_club
scripts.migrate: python -m uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py migrate
scripts.seed: npm run migrate && python -m uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py seed_demo
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "python -m uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.gen:api: python -m uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py export_openapi_schema --api api.api.api --output openapi.json && npm --prefix frontend run gen:api
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:web
scripts.test:py: python -m uv run --project backend python -m pytest backend -q
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.createsuperuser: python -m uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py createsuperuser
